assumptions: One module instance, two representative encodings, two load attempts per encoding, and four one-shot callers. Map admission and promise capture are synchronous.

The failure cleanup reaction is registered before the promise is returned. A caller can join before cleanup, but rejection observation follows that reaction. Successful entries persist for the module lifetime.
The model separates caller observations from import outcomes. Exact rank bytes, module-loader caching, runtime model configuration, process restart and unbounded requests are outside its state space.
bounds.progress: A waiting caller settles when its physical import and enabled promise reactions eventually run. It may receive a rejection. No wall-clock or guaranteed load-success claim.

assumptions: Each enabled import outcome eventually arrives, possibly as a rejection.
The event loop eventually runs each continuously enabled rejection cleanup and caller observation.
No import-completion or event-loop fairness is assumed. A pending import can remain unresolved.
